headline: Agricultural producers block roads in Guanajuato and Jalisco
summary: Agricultural producers blocked roads at 25 or more points in Guanajuato, Querétaro, Michoacán, Jalisco and Campeche. Guanajuato farmers lifted blockades at 11 points after about seven hours of protest and virtual talks with authorities.
why: Mexico's agricultural output feeds domestic food supply and exports, and road blockades disrupt the freight and logistics that move goods across the country.
original_headline: Productores agrícolas bloquean carreteras de Guanajuato y Jalisco
